name: compare-split
description: 左右对比：Before/After 双栏对照
css: #tpl-compare-split { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; } #tpl-compare-split .cp-side { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 7%; } #tpl-compare-split .cp-left { background: #14141f; } #tpl-compare-split .cp-right { background: #101a2e; } #tpl-compare-split .cp-title { font-size: 40px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 5px; text-transform: uppercase; } #tpl-compare-split .cp-left .cp-title { color: #9aa4c8; } #tpl-compare-split .cp-right .cp-title { color: #3ecf8e; } #tpl-compare-split .cp-text { font-size: 44px; line-height: 1.4; color: #ffffff; margin-top: 26px; }
